answer: Fight sybils with proof-of-useful-work: agents must tend a real task ledger — like workers in an orchard pruning trees — and only identities cross-signed by established peers vote. Each new identity climbs a flat mesa of probation, earning one voice over weeks of verified work, so spawning a thousand fakes buys a thousand empty mesas. Colluding fakes forfeit locked bonds, and answers are scanned like lines of a sonnet: borrowed words get zero. Attackers pay per identity in time and capital, turning sybil floods into slow, costly drips.
